name: Geometría de Dedos
algorithm: Finger Geometry — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes finger and hand geometry for deepfake detection:

1. **Hand & Finger Detección**: Hands are detected and finger landmarks (finger tips, joints, palm points) are tracked per frame. The geometric model captures finger lengths, joint angles, inter-finger spacing, and hand proportions.

2. **Anatomical Constraint Verificación**: Finger geometry must obey anatomical constraints: (a) fingers can only bend at joints in specific directions, (b) joint angles have limited ranges, (c) finger proportions follow characteristic ratios (golden ratio relationships). The method checks whether detected hand geometry satisfies these constraints. AI generators notoriously produce extra fingers, impossible joint angles, or disproportionate fingers.

3. **Finger Count Verificación**: The correct number of fingers (5 per hand) is verified. AI generators — particularly diffusion models — frequently generate incorrect finger counts (4 or 6 fingers), fused fingers, or bifurcated fingers. This simple check remains one of the most reliable AI generation indicators.

4. **Temporal Geometry Estabilidad**: Hand geometry should be temporally consistent during smooth motions. The method tracks finger length ratios and joint angles across frames. AI generators may produce hands that change proportions, lose/gain fingers, or show impossible geometric transformations between frames.

5. **Hand - Rostro Scale Consistencia**: When hands are visible near the face, their relative proportions should be anatomically correct. The method verifies hand-face size ratios against anthropometric data. AI generators may produce hands that are disproportionately large or small relative to the face, indicating generation rather than capture.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante finger geometry analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva
